definitions.gloss: state of emergency; emergency situation; crisis
definitions.explanation: A serious, urgent, or dangerous situation requiring immediate action. Can refer to officially declared states of emergency by governments or to critical situations in everyday life.

examples.japanese: {非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A state of emergency has occurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The government issued a state of emergency declaration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まり→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: Heavy snow stopped transportation and the city fell into a state of emergency.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both official government declarations and informal descriptions of serious situations. The compound {非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧ (state of emergency declaration) became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧ (state of emergency declaration)
- {非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (to fall into a state of emergency)
- {非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ (an emergency occurs)
- {非常事態|ひじょうじたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ (to prepare for emergencies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緊急事態|きんきゅうじたい}→緊急事態：16936_kinkyuujitai⟧: emergency — very similar, used interchangeably in many contexts
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧: emergency, extraordinary — the base word, used as a prefix
- ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧: crisis — more abstract, often used for political or economic crises
